name: EPIC 246495916

text.card: A red giant 1,574 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.82 solar masses and 8.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,709 K at its surface.
